T: Dinner with the mutants. Staten Island, by the water.
D: Four teenage turtle brothers want to be accepted in New York and try to stop a gang of mutants.
P: Serve the sliders when Superfly crushes the ketchup bottle.
S: Pork and garlic chive dumplings, crisp underneath then steamed, soy and black vinegar. Up top for supplies only.

Mix 400g pork mince with 1 bunch finely chopped garlic chives, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, pleat and seal. Fry in 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a lidded pan until the bases are golden, add 100ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes. Serve with soy sauce and Chinese black vinegar mixed half and half.
Beef smashed thin on a screaming hot plate, American cheese, pickles and plenty of tomato sauce on soft buns. Molly-whopped.

Roll 500g beef mince into 8 balls. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the balls and smash flat with a spatula. Season, cook 2 minutes until the edges crust, flip, add a slice of American cheese and cook 1 minute more. Serve on 8 toasted slider buns with sliced dill pickles, finely diced onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
Oven fries under beef chilli and melted cheddar, jalapeños and spring onion. Leatherhead says g'day.

Bake 1kg frozen thick fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 tsp chilli powder, add a 400g tin kidney beans and 200ml passata and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon over the fries, top with 150g grated cheddar, melt under the grill and finish with sliced jalapeños and spring onion.
M: Pizza-box pepperoni pie with jalapeño ranch
Thin New York pie, red sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, pickled jalapeños and a ranch drizzle. Can we explain this over some pizza?

Stretch 500g pizza dough thin on an oiled tray. Spread with 150ml pizza sauce, scatter 250g grated mozzarella and 150g pepperoni and sprinkle 1 tsp dried oregano. Bake at the oven's highest setting for 10 to 12 minutes. Scatter 50g pickled jalapeños over the hot pie, drizzle with 80ml ranch dressing and cut into big New York slices.
Everything on it: Italian sausage, mushroom, bell pepper, red onion, olives. Whale-sized, from half the zoo.

Divide 1kg pizza dough in two and stretch thin. Spread each with 125ml passata and a pinch of oregano, scatter 400g grated mozzarella between them and top with 300g crumbled Italian sausage, 150g sliced mushrooms, 1 sliced green capsicum, 1 sliced red onion and a handful of black olives. Bake at the oven's highest setting for 12 minutes.
W: Vanilla cupcakes piped with bright green buttercream ooze. Where the whole mutant family started.

Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Divide between 12 cupcake cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool. Beat 125g soft butter with 250g icing sugar and a few drops of green food colouring until fluffy and pipe on in drips.
K: Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream with a maraschino cherry.
Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Slowly pour 1.2L cherry cola over and top each with a maraschino cherry. Serve with long spoons and straws.
